data.text:
Sanjay Agrawal vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party(S) on 17
May, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crlmc No.818 Of 2024 
 Sanjay Agrawal .... Petitioner(s)
 Mr. S. K. Joshi, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party(s)
 Mr. B. K. Ragada, Aga
 Coram: Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
 Order 
17.05.2024 Order No.
01. 1. Heard. 
2. The Petitioner has challenged the order dated 16.01.2022 passed by the learned J.M.F.C.,
Kantabanji in G.R. Case No.28 of 2021, whereby the learned Court below has taken cognizance of offences under Sections 420/270/269 of I.P.C. read with Sections 51/53/54/59/61/63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act against him.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that he does not want to press this present petition at this stage reserving his right to raise all the points before the Court below. However, he submits that during investigation, the Petitioner was served a notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and after the cognizance was taken, summons has been issued against him, therefore, he may be protected.
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner on instruction from his client undertakes that his client would be appearing before the Court below on or before 30.06.2024 and seek remedy available to him under law by relying upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Mahdoom Bava vrs. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in 2023 Live Law (SC) 218.
5. With this liberty, the CRLMC is disposed of. 
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Swarna Location: High Court of Orissa Sanjay Agrawal vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party(S) on 17 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42080707/
